title: What are your intentions? (Opening the Temple)
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett's main teaching is that true freedom and peace come from letting go of our attachment to specific outcomes and instead embracing the beauty of impermanence and uncertainty. By practicing mindfulness and presence, we can learn to be fully engaged with the present moment, taking care of ourselves and others with kindness and compassion, without striving for some idealized state or expectation. This approach encourages us to find peace in the midst of change and uncertainty, rather than trying to control or manipulate our experiences.
